recipient.description: Phone number in international format without +.

sender.description: The name or phone number of the sender. Please note that alphanumeric sender is not supported in all countries. If `allowVoice` is `true`, sender must be a phone number. For alphanumeric senders, the length should be between 3 and 11 characters.

allowVoice.description: Send the code via a voice call.

voiceLanguage.description: Change the language of the voice call.

allowPush.description: Allow code to be send via push notification. When allowPush is set to `true`, a valid app key is required.

message.description: Set a custom message. You can use the placeholder {code} which will be replaced by the actual code. e.g. Your code is: {code}."
